dataset: Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW)
method: BLS annual area CSVs, all published source rows concatenated for 2023, 2024 and 2025. Original values and flags preserved; city_name and metro_cbsa added. 2025 contains only all-industry/all-ownership total.

key_variables: EMP; EMP_F; EMP_N; PAYANN; PAYANN_F; ESTAB
units: Employees; payroll in thousand USD; establishments
method: Official CB2300CBP metro response, all returned broad-industry and employment-size rows for the target CBSA and YEAR=2023. All original field names and flags preserved; no extra industry/size filter.

units: Revenue and payroll in thousand USD; employees; establishments
method: Official EC2200BASIC metro response, all returned target-CBSA 2022 detail rows. NAICS2022 and NAICS2022_LABEL renamed NAICS_CODE and NAICS_LABEL; NAICS_VINTAGE=2022 added; JSON nulls serialized as blanks. No suppressed value imputed.

dataset: 2022 Economic Census: All Sectors Summary Statistics (EC2200BASIC)
units: Revenue and payroll in thousand USD; employees; establishments
method: Same EC2200BASIC response, target CBSA, TYPOP=00, TAXSTAT=00, NAICS2022 in 22;31-33;42;44-45;48-49;51;52;53;54;56;61;62;71;72;81. Same documented renames and null serialization as detail.

source_vintage: BEA 2026-02-05 county GDP release; 2024 and revised 2023 estimates
method: Official BEA CAGDP2 rows for every July 2023 OMB constituent county/county equivalent, preserving any published combined reporting areas, reshaped to 2023 and 2024. All industry lines and source markers are retained. Add only complete numeric all-industry metro sums; do not impute unavailable periods. See bea_reporting_area_to_constituent_fips for exact component coverage.

dataset: State Corporate Income Tax Rates and Brackets, 2026
method: Transcribe the 2026 table only, one row for every July 2023 OMB constituent state. Numeric field stores the highest published statutory rate including qualifying surtaxes; source_display and notes retain all brackets, exemption thresholds and surcharge conditions. Separate state regimes are not averaged.

source_vintage: 2025 Fortune interactive map data retrieved 2026-10-27; current HQ verification incomplete
method: Public data.csv linked by map/app.js on Fortune’s 2025 interactive. Select headquarters points inside the target 2023 Census CBSA polygon. Retain reported national rank, company and municipality. Decode legacy Mac Roman source text to UTF-8; trim incidental name whitespace. The 17-column schema is preserved. Current-headquarters fields remain blank because no complete independent audit was performed. Reported US locations need not be legal domicile or all co-headquarters. Where the location string omits a state, infer it from the municipality and assigned metro geography; this is not an independent address verification.

dataset: County Business Patterns: Number of Establishments (ESTAB)
method: Establishment-specific projection of the same official CB2300CBP metro response as row 2; target CBSA and YEAR=2023; preserves ESTAB and flags, NAICS2017, LFO, EMPSZES and their labels.

source_vintage: BDSMETRO response retrieved 2026-10-27; selected reference year 2023
key_variables: ESTABS_ENTRY; ESTABS_EXIT; ESTABS_ENTRY_RATE; ESTABS_EXIT_RATE; JOB_CREATION; JOB_DESTRUCTION
method: Official BDSMETRO response, target CBSA and YEAR=2023. All returned total/broad industry rows and every original measure/flag retained. Same single-year window as Dallas and Denver.
